notes:
- Feature: runs with Chrome minimized. While auto-trade is on (and Keep awake is ticked), the extension also asks Windows not to sleep (chrome.power, new "power" permission, no install warning; released when auto-trade stops or the tab closes). The keep-awake tone already keeps Chrome from pausing a hidden or minimized tab.
- Feature: background health in the Log and Copy diagnostics: "Page hidden ... keep-awake tone on, PC sleep blocked" when Chrome is minimized or another tab is shown, and "Page visible again after N min hidden: X candles closed and were checked, longest timer delay Y s" when it comes back. Warns while hidden if the tone is not playing (after a reload Chrome needs one click on the page) or if Chrome paused the tab for more than 10 s.
